welcome.title: Welcome to Winlestia
welcome.sub: A calmer, better looking surface for Windows 11. Your files, windows and wallpaper stay as they are; only the shell changes.
welcome.b1: Installed for your account only, in your user folder. No administrator rights.
welcome.b2: Nothing changes on your PC until you confirm on the summary screen.
welcome.b3: You choose which parts of Windows Winlestia replaces, and you can change it later.
welcome.b4: The Windows taskbar can always be brought back, with one shortcut.
welcome.sub.installed: Choose what to do. Nothing changes until you confirm.
welcome.update.d: Replaces the program files, keeps your settings and keeps a copy of the previous version.
welcome.modify.d: Turn parts of Winlestia on or off. Program files are not touched.
welcome.uninstall.d: Restores the Windows taskbar first, then removes Winlestia. You choose what happens to your data.

features.title: Features
features.sub: Pick what Winlestia replaces. The choice is written to its settings at install time.
feat.action: Install action, not a setting: runs the terminal integration script.
feat.nokey: No setting exists for this: it cannot be turned off from the installer.
feat.taskbar.name: Windows taskbar
feat.taskbar.desc: Winlestia can hide the Windows taskbar and take its place.
feat.taskbar.on: The Windows taskbar is hidden while Winlestia runs. It comes back when you quit Winlestia.
feat.taskbar.off: The Windows taskbar stays where it is. Winlestia runs next to it.
feat.dock.name: Dock
feat.dock.desc: The bar at the bottom edge: pinned apps, running apps, system status.
feat.dock.on: The dock appears when you move the pointer to the bottom edge, and hides again.
feat.dock.off: No dock. You open apps from the command palette (Ctrl+F2) or the launcher.
feat.panels.name: Panels
feat.panels.desc: Dashboard, notifications, launcher, quick controls and command palette.
feat.panels.locked: These panels are the core of Winlestia and have no on/off setting, so the switch is locked. Open them with Ctrl+F1 (dashboard) and Ctrl+F2 (command palette).
feat.winjets.name: Winjets
feat.winjets.desc: Desktop widgets placed behind your windows: clock, calendar, battery, markets, player.
feat.winjets.locked: Winjets have no global on/off setting. Six packages are installed and none is placed on your desktop until you add one in Settings, Winjets.
feat.terminal.name: Terminal
feat.terminal.desc: Winlestia colours for Command Prompt and PowerShell, following your wallpaper.
feat.terminal.on: Applies the theme through Clink and adds PowerShell profile entries. Needs an Internet connection (Clink download). Reversible.
feat.terminal.off: Your terminals are left as they are. If the integration was on, it is removed.
feat.pill.name: Pill
feat.pill.desc: A capsule at the top of the screen that shows up only when something happens.
feat.pill.on: Music, volume, brightness and microphone changes appear in the pill, then it disappears.
feat.pill.off: No pill. The edge indicator is used instead.
feat.rails.name: Side rails
feat.rails.desc: Social and bookmarks rails at the screen edge.
feat.rails.on: Both rails are available at the edge of the screen.
feat.rails.off: No rails. Bookmarks and messages are not shown at the screen edge.
updates.title: Updates
updates.sub: Winlestia never updates itself in the background. You decide when.
updates.s1: Download the new setup and run it. It finds the existing installation and shows the installed and the new version.
updates.s2: It keeps a copy of the previous version in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Winlestia-backups, so you can go back.
updates.s3: Your settings and profile are kept. The shell is closed, files are replaced, then you can start it again.
updates.s4: No silent update, no background service, no check you did not ask for.
updates.notify.d: Would check GitHub Releases for lilidoxdev/winlestia. The shell has no such check yet, so this switch does nothing for now.
summary.title: Ready to go
summary.sub: Check the list. Nothing has changed yet.
summary.backup: The previous version is kept in a backup folder.
summary.fresh: Fresh install: nothing to back up.
summary.close: The running Winlestia shell is closed first.
summary.nothing: Nothing is changed before you click the button below.
progress.title: Installing
progress.sub: This takes a minute. Please keep this window open.
progress.sub.u: The Windows taskbar comes back first.
step.restore: Restoring the Windows taskbar and explorer.exe
step.undo: Undoing folder handler and terminal integration
step.files: Sending files to the Recycle Bin
done.title: Winlestia is installed
done.sub: Start it now, or sign out and in again. It starts at sign-in.
done.dry: Dry run: nothing was written. See the log in your temp folder.
done.failed.sub: The installation stopped. Your previous version, if any, is in the backup folder.
safety.title: If something looks wrong
safety.s1: Press Ctrl+Alt+Backspace: Winlestia quits and the Windows taskbar returns.
safety.s4: Or uninstall from Settings, Apps, Installed apps.
uconfirm.title: Uninstall Winlestia?
uconfirm.sub: Windows comes back as it was. Here is exactly what will happen.
uconfirm.g1: The Windows taskbar and explorer.exe are restored first, and checked at the end.
uconfirm.g2: Nothing is deleted for good. Files go to the Recycle Bin.
uconfirm.g3: The only program folder removed is {0}. Any other path is refused.
uconfirm.g4: If a folder cannot be sent to the Recycle Bin, it is left in place and you are told.
uconfirm.keep.d: Settings, profile, wallpapers and Winjets in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Panneaux and \Winlestia stay.
uconfirm.remove.d: The folders Panneaux, Winlestia and "Panneaux · Caelestia Windows" in %LOCALAPPDATA%, plus the Winlestia-backups folder, go to the Recycle Bin.
done.u.title: Winlestia is uninstalled
done.u.sub: Windows is back to its own shell.
done.u.taskbar.no: The taskbar could not be confirmed. Sign out and in again if it is missing.
done.u.data.removed: Your data was sent to the Recycle Bin.
done.u.bin: Restore anything from the Recycle Bin if you change your mind.
